# Centro Containers

Centro Containers supports build-to-print manufacturing of steel container components for B2B repeat-volume programs. Buyers can begin with a drawing, sample or specification; manufacturability and quotation are reviewed against the supplied requirement.

Project-specific tolerances, documentation, economical quantities and production timing are confirmed during manufacturing review and quotation.

Main products:
- Corner casting
- Corner post
- Cross member
- Roof panel
- Side panel
- Door panel
- Door gasket
- Door locking gear
- Bridge fitting

Primary buyers include container manufacturers, equipment-container builders, OEM purchasing teams and component distributors. Standard replacement parts remain available as a secondary offer. Rolling shutter doors are presented as a separate product line.
